about: Conversions the AKI team tested (aki-roadmap#172, #228): hashes and notes only, no ROM or hack data. inputs.sha1: the hack ROM (.z64 order) a player imports; outputs.sha1: the ROM the tested package's patch makes from the port ROM; outputs.codes_sha1: its codes.txt; outputs.content_sha1: its saves and texture images, for packs with no patch or codes (the entry then also names the built conversion). A player-built package gets the tier only when its output matches; otherwise it is Untested.

tiers.verified: Verified: plays through a match like the original on an emulator.
tiers.untested: Untested: built by aki-import, not tested by the AKI team; it may crash.
